description: Send a direct message to a buyer regarding a specific transaction or inquiry. Use this to communicate about orders, answer questions, resolve issues, or provide updates.

conversationId.description: ID of existing conversation (required if sending in existing conversation)

emailCopyToSender.description: Whether to email a copy to the sender

messageMedia.description: Array of up to 5 media attachments

mediaType.description: Type of media: IMAGE, PDF, DOC, TXT

mediaUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the self-hosted media

messageText.description: The text of the message (max 2000 characters)

otherPartyUsername.description: eBay username to send message to (required for new conversations)

reference.description: Reference to associate with the conversation

referenceId.description: The reference ID (e.g., item ID for LISTING)

referenceType.description: The reference type (currently only LISTING is supported)

name: ebay_send_message
